name: czgame_frame_on_activate
description: CZGameFrame::OnActivate forwards to CFrameWnd, notifies the current RecoilApp state, then dispatches app/input/video lifecycle work by activation state.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x443ae0 validates CFrameWnd::OnActivate first, current-state OnWndActivate dispatch through slot 0x04 when present, app OnAppDeactivate/zInput::OnAppDeactivate/zGame::ReturnOnlyStub for nState 0, and app OnAppActivate/zInput::OnAppActivate/zVideo_RestoreIconicFullscreenWindowIfNeeded for nonzero nState.
The native smoke patches the MFC/provider callees and verifies both branch call orders plus the state nState argument.
